task: Fix nested sub-assistant message-history corruption in the LangGraph supervisor pre-model hook (EPMCDME-14859) by deferring and re-emitting the supervisor's handoff-call AIMessage around nested sub-agent tool exchanges, and avoid overwriting an already-successful streamed answer with a later error message

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: Modifies core message-history reconstruction logic that feeds directly into LLM provider API calls (Azure/OpenAI); malformed tool_call/tool_response sequences cause production-breaking 400 errors across every supervisor-based multi-agent conversation; the defer/re-emit state machine for the supervisor's handoff-call AIMessage has no exact prior pattern in the codebase
technical_risk.mitigation: Comprehensive unit tests added covering single-handoff, parallel-handoff, deferred re-emit, and no-response placeholder paths, including a protocol-level invariant assertion that every ToolMessage is preceded by a matching AIMessage.tool_calls entry

key_reasoning.reason: The fix rewrites the defer/re-emit logic for supervisor handoff-call AIMessages inside a pre-model hook that runs on every supervisor turn; getting the message-sequence invariant wrong causes 400 errors from Azure/OpenAI across all multi-agent conversations, and no equivalent pattern existed in the codebase before this change.

10 total files changed per diffstat (mapped via the actual-mode N-to-score table to L); 4 are real modified source/test files (langgraph_agent.py, history.py, 2 test files) and 6 are SDLC planning artifacts newly created under the task's docs run_dir.

Component Scope bumped from S to M: the pre_model_hook in supervisor/history.py is shared by every supervisor-based agent with subagents, so the fix affects multiple workflows/agents, not a single isolated call site.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from S to M: touches the shared supervisor pre_model_hook used by all multi-agent (subagent) workflows, satisfying the 'affects multiple workflows or agents' red flag.
